name: provider
title: Kineto provider
description: Mount once in the root layout: loads the stylesheet and starts Kineto.observe() so any data-kt-* element that reaches the DOM is animated and cleaned up automatically.
author: dongri <official@dongri.me>
docs: Add <KinetoProvider> around your app once (a client component). Then put data-kt-* attributes on any shadcn component, e.g. <Card data-kt-tilt="tilt-glare">.
